title: Devious Distraction (ORIGINAL)
description: The next file in the "The Two Sides" mini-series that starts with "Sleight of Voice". Do you ever find yourself… getting distracted? Would you describe yourself as easily distracted in fact? Focusing can be so incredibly difficult, in certain circumstances, or to look at it from another perspective… Some things can be extremely enticing, so alluring that it’s impossible to look away, even if your mind should be focussed on something else... You just can’t stop yourself. You feel this urge. This pull. This Irresistible force pulling you towards it. Capturing your gaze... And just like the other files in this series, I’m going to use that knowledge against you. A sort of magic trick, if you like. So you can be doing anything you like right now, you can be playing a computer game, reading a book, watching a series, or just going about your day. I encourage the distraction. Being distracted is good. All you have to do is focus on my voice, this voice, the one that is speaking to you right now. In a moment, I’m going to start spinning around and around and around, and you’re going to hear another voice, trailing behind this one. A little bit softer, a little bit quieter. But that’s okay if you can’t really make out what I’m saying, I don’t want you to listen actively… Focus on my voice as it spins around your head, while my true intentions are whispered into your subconscious. This is all just a distraction. A simple, yet brilliant devious distraction.
author: Mistress Shibby
